epics.title: Telemetry and Success Measurement for Designer Engine
epics.jtbd: When operating the designer engine, I want to measure the generation success rate and visual audit scores, so that I know whether the system successfully replaces external paid design services.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Categorization of underlying defect events without rootCausePatternId
requirements: R1: Identify and assign missing rootCausePatternId to underlying defect events for the 'reviewConcerns' telemetry stream to bring the u-chart back within control limits.

slices.title: Patch defect processor to map missing rootCausePatternId for review concerns
slices.jtbd: When implementing root cause pattern identification for this epic, I want to assign rootCausePatternId to uncategorized defect events, so that the telemetry accurately tracks design review concerns.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an uncategorized defect event in the reviewConcerns stream, When the event is processed, Then a valid rootCausePatternId is successfully assigned.
Given the patched telemetry pipeline, When unit and integration tests are executed, Then they verify that the rootCausePatternId mapping restores statistical control.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Uncategorized defect events in the reviewConcerns stream
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Mockup visual audit pass rate on first iteration
